message:
Validate supervisor declaration on every ensure call (uniform fail-closed)

A malformed agentd.supervisor.json might be declaring any socket, so
ensure_agentd loads it unconditionally and surfaces the typed config
error immediately - config typos show up right after deploy, not at the
next restart window. Library and CLI semantics now agree.
